title: AnomalyAgent: Agentic Industrial Anomaly Synthesis via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.07900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Industrial anomaly generation is a crucial method for alleviating the data scarcity problem in anomaly detection tasks. Most existing anomaly synthesis methods rely on single-step generation mechanisms, lacking complex reasoning and iterative optimization capabilities, making it difficult to generate anomaly samples with high semantic realism. We propose AnomalyAgent, an anomaly synthesis agent with self-reflection, knowledge retrieval, and iterative refinement capabilities, aiming to generate realistic and diverse anomalies. Specifically, AnomalyAgent is equipped with five tools: Prompt Generation (PG), Image Generation (IG), Quality Evaluation (QE), Knowledge Retrieval (KR), and Mask Generation (MG), enabling closed-loop optimization. To improve decision-making and self-reflection, we construct structured trajectories from real anomaly images and design a two-stage training framework: supervised fine-tuning followed by reinfo

translated_title: AnomalyAgent：基于工具增强强化学习的智能体式工业异常合成
translated_abstract: 工业异常生成是缓解异常检测任务中数据稀缺问题的重要方法。现有的大多数异常合成方法依赖单步生成机制，缺乏复杂推理和迭代优化能力，难以生成具有高语义真实感的异常样本。我们提出AnomalyAgent，一个具备自我反思、知识检索和迭代优化能力的异常合成智能体，旨在生成真实且多样的异常。具体而言，AnomalyAgent配备了五个工具：提示词生成（PG）、图像生成（IG）、质量评估（QE）、知识检索（KR）和掩码生成（MG），从而实现闭环优化。为提升决策与自我反思能力，我们基于真实异常图像构建结构化轨迹，并设计了两阶段训练框架：先进行监督微调，再进行强化学习训练（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出AnomalyAgent异常合成智能体，通过配备提示词生成、图像生成、质量评估、知识检索和掩码生成五种工具实现闭环优化，并采用监督微调加强化学习的两阶段训练，生成高真实感且多样的工业异常样本，以缓解异常检测的数据稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: AnomalyAgent is an anomaly synthesis agent equipped with five tools enabling closed-loop optimization, trained through a two-stage framework of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, to generate realistic and diverse industrial anomalies for alleviating data scarcity in anomaly detection.
